default.description:
The value used when it's left out, as written (a set's members joined
by `|`).

required.description: Whether every use must give it.

values.description:
The values it allows, for `enum` and a `set` of named values; empty
otherwise.

availability.description:
How it treats availability: `badge`, or the target it filters for,
such as `filter self-managed 3.3`.

editor.description: Whether it's the build the editor checks (`[editor] build`).

line.description:
For a line of a versioned build, the line, as `[releases.<target>]`
writes it.

variants.description:
Which variant arms it keeps: `switch` for all of them, or the
selection, such as `deployment=cloud`.

versions.description: For a line of a versioned build, the target it's versioned by.

versionless.description:
Whether it has no versions, so an availability spec gives it a state
but no version.

files.description:
How many of the files the source makes readable its config makes
examples.

observations.description: Its observations, in name order: those that can't be read left out.

valid.description:
Whether its `ascribe.examples.toml` can be read. One that can't makes
no file an example.

key.description: Its key, which an availability spec can name.

description.description: What it's for, as the content model describes it.

fields.description: An object's fields; empty for any other type.

required.description: Whether every page of the type must give it.

type.description: Its type in short form: `string`, `list(string)`, `enum(a, b)`.

values.description:
The values it allows, for an enumeration or a list of one; empty
otherwise.

builds.description:
The builds that are this line, one for each build versioned by the
target: `site@3.4`, or `site` for the current line.

line.description: The line, as the list writes it.

label.description:
Its label: its `nav-label` as plain text, else its title, else its
file name without `.md`.

source.description: Its path from the content root.

type.description: Its content type's name, when it has one.

ModelNavSection.description: A section of the navigation: a folder and its pages, in order.

folder.description: The folder, from the content root, ending in `/`; `""` for the root.

label.description:
Its label: from `ascribe.nav`, else its own page's title, else its
folder's name with `-` and `_` as spaces and its first letter
capitalized, and "Start" for the root.

page.description:
Its own page: its `index.md`, or the page beside the folder with its
name, which is then one of the parent's `pages` too.

pages.description: Its pages in order, its own page not among them.

sections.description:
Its nested sections with a page, in order: each one whose own page
is among `pages` right after that page, then the rest.

ModelObservation.description: An observation of a source's examples.

current.description:
How many of those are as it found them: the rest changed since, or
are gone.

environment.description:
Its environment as it has it, by name: `os`, `arch`, and each
entry's kept line.

listed.description:
How many files it lists. For a source in another repository, only
those it has copies of, since the others weren't copied.

name.description: Its name: `default`, or the name `ascribe observe --name` gave it.

tested.description: What a page says it was tested with, by this observation alone.

key.description: Its key, written `{key}` in a page.

lines.description: Its lines, newest first: planned, live, then archived.

target.description: The target: a versioned dimension value.

ModelRemote.description: The repository a source is in.

branch.description: The branch an update follows; `null` for the repository's default.

ModelSource.description: A source: a folder of files, such as code, that pages can show.

examples.description:
Its tested examples, for a source with an `ascribe.examples.toml`:
absent for any other. For a source in another repository, they're
read from its copies.

git.description: The repository it's in, for a source in another repository.

ignore.description:
The patterns of the files it doesn't make readable, though `include`
matches them.

include.description:
The patterns of the files it makes readable, relative to its folder;
empty for every file.

name.description: Its name, as addresses write it: `code:` for a source named `code`.

path.description:
Its folder, relative to the project's folder: the `path` written,
or, for a source in another repository, the folder of its copies.

ModelTerm.description:
A glossary term: a heading marked `@term` on a glossary page. Its
definition is the paragraph under the heading, which differs by build:
the JSON output of a build has it.

case_sensitive.description: Whether an occurrence must match its case.

line.description: The heading's line in that file, from 1.

match.description:
Which occurrences are linked: `first` on each page, `every` one, or
only those an author links (`marked`).

page.description:
The file its heading is written in, from the content root: its
glossary page, or a fragment the page includes.

fields.description: Its frontmatter fields, in declaration order.

guide.description:
What to read before writing a page of the type, in the order to read
it, from the folder `ascribe.toml` is in; absent when the type names
none.

name.description:
Its name, which each page of the type gives as its `type`; the
implicit `page` type's pages give none.

purpose.description:
What a page of the type is for, as the content model says; absent
when it says nothing.

template.description:
The page a page of the type starts from, from the folder
`ascribe.toml` is in; absent when the type names none.

container.description: Whether it may be a container, closed by `@end`.

description.description: What it's for, as the content model describes it.

line.description: Whether it may be one line.

description:
What `ascribe model --format json` answers: the content model's sections,
or the one asked for.

ascribe_version.description: The version of Ascribe that wrote it.

builds.description:
Builds, in declaration order, a versioned build as one for each live
line, the current line first.

glossary.description:
Glossary terms, in the order of `[glossary] pages`, and on each page
in document order.

navigation.description:
The project's navigation, its root section: every page that isn't
`unlisted`, in order, as each build's `_ascribe/nav.json` has its
share of it. Only in the whole report.

releases.description:
`[releases.<target>]`, in declaration order: each target's lines,
with their status.

schema_version.description:
The version of this schema. It changes only when a field is removed
or changes meaning.

types.description:
Page types, in declaration order: the implicit `page` type when none
is declared.

title: ModelReport
